title: Detecting and Guiding LLM-Generated Korean Poetry with Interpretable Form-level Features
abstract: arXiv:2608.28986v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs often struggle with modern Korean poetry, producing outputs that resemble "line-broken prose." We address two coupled tasks: detecting whether a Korean poem is human- or LLM-authored, and guiding LLMs to generate poetry closer in form to human writing. We quantify the human-LLM gap along four form-level linguistic dimensions: output length (Volume), the diversity and connective use of line-final forms (Structure Variation), the irregularity of line lengths (Rhythmic Irregularity), and adherence to standard orthography (Normative Adherence). translated_title: 基于可解释的形式层面特征检测与引导LLM生成的韩语诗歌
translated_abstract: LLM在创作现代韩语诗歌方面常常表现不佳，其输出往往类似于“断行的散文”。我们解决了两个相互关联的任务：检测韩语诗歌是人类创作还是LLM创作，以及引导LLM生成在形式上更接近人类写作的诗歌。我们从四个形式层面的语言学维度量化了人类与LLM之间的差距：输出长度（Volume，篇幅）、行尾形式的多样性与连接性使用（Structure Variation，结构变化）、行长的不规则性（Rhythmic Irregularity，节奏不规则性），以及对标准正字法的遵循程度（Normative Adherence，规范性遵循）。我们将这些维度操作化为五个可解释的特征。在检测任务上，基于这五个特征的逻辑回归分类器在七个未见过的LLM上的零样本分布外检测中取得了83.60的平均AUC-ROC，而我们对比中最强的基线KatFishNet为75.84，绝对提升7.76个AUC点，相对提升10.23%；一个生成器……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究提出五个可解释的形式层面语言学特征，既能高精度检测韩语诗歌是人类还是LLM创作（零样本分布外检测AUC-ROC达83.60，超越最强基线7.76个点），又能引导LLM生成在形式上更接近人类写作的诗歌。
en_tdlr: This work introduces five interpretable form-level linguistic features that both detect whether Korean poems are human- or LLM-authored with strong zero-shot out-of-distribution performance (AUC-ROC 83.60, surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.76 points) and guide LLMs to generate poetry whose form is closer to human writing.
